transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Yeah, um, I’m here because... well, after my cashier shifts, I just keep buying these huge takeout orders. Like, I'll get enough burgers, fries, chicken, and desserts for an entire family. And I'll just sit there and eat almost all of it by myself before I even go home. It's just... it's gotten really out of hand.
Do you often eat much more rapidly than normal, eat until you're uncomfortably full, or eat large amounts even when you're not hungry? And do you ever do this in secret because you're embarrassed?

Yeah, I do. Um... a lot of nights I just keep eating until my stomach gets really tight. It gets to the point where it's hurting so bad that I have to lean the seat back in the car, or just lie completely still in bed and wait for the pain to pass. And yeah, I definitely do it by myself in the car because... well, I wouldn't want anyone to see me eating like that.
How often does this happen, and does it ever interfere with your daily life or make you feel bad about yourself?

Well, for the last several months, it's been happening, like, three or four nights most weeks. Honestly, I can't even remember a week where I didn't do it at least once... not since the foreclosure calls started, anyway. And yeah, it makes me feel terrible about myself. I just feel so guilty and ashamed after I do it, and the stomach pain definitely messes with my sleep and how I feel the next day.
After you eat like that, do you ever make yourself vomit, take laxatives, or exercise a lot to try to get rid of the calories or control your weight?

No, I don't do any of that. I don't throw up or take anything, and I definitely don't exercise. I just... I just sit there with the stomach ache and feel bad about it. I never try to get rid of it afterwards.
Has this eating behavior caused any problems with your work, relationships, or other important areas of your life?

Well, I still manage to get to my cashier shifts on time, so work is okay. But... it's definitely causing issues at home. I'm spending money on all this food that we really don't have right now, especially with the house stuff going on. And I'm hiding it all from my wife. Keeping secrets like that... it just makes everything at home feel really tense and dishonest.
When you're eating all that food in one sitting, do you feel like you can't stop yourself or control how much you're eating?

Yeah, that's exactly how it feels. It's like... once I take that first bite, something inside me just clicks off. I'll actually be sitting there telling myself, "Demetrius, stop, you don't need any more," but it's like my hands just keep reaching for the next thing anyway. I just can't seem to stop once I start.
